prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and preferred channels. That said, Kansas City does have several highly regarded agencies. Two well-known KC-based options are:

- Barkley — large, full-service creative agency with strong brand and advertising work; good if you need big-brand creative, national campaigns or integrated strategy.  
- VML (now part of VMLY&R) — global digital and experience agency with Kansas City roots; good for digital transformation, UX, and integrated digital campaigns.

How I can help next
- Tell me your business type (B2B or B2C), primary goal (brand awareness, lead gen, e‑commerce growth, etc.), approximate monthly/annual marketing budget, and whether you want local in-person work or are fine with remote.  
- I’ll return a tailored shortlist of 4–6 Kansas City agencies (or nearby regional firms), each with why they’d be a fit, examples of the work to look for, and suggested questions to ask them.

Want me to prepare that shortlist? If yes, share the details above.
